{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh

# Flux batch script (translated from PBS)

# PBS requested:
#   -W group_list=hpcstats
#   -l nodes=1,walltime=10:00:00,mem=2gb
#   -V
#   -e localhost:/hpc/stats/users/dbp2112/Janelia/logs/stderr.txt
#   -o localhost:/hpc/stats/users/dbp2112/Janelia/logs/stdout.txt

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  --time=10h \
  bash -lc '

# Approximate PBS stdout/stderr file directives (strip the "localhost:" prefix for local paths).
mkdir -p /hpc/stats/users/dbp2112/Janelia/logs
exec >"/hpc/stats/users/dbp2112/Janelia/logs/stdout.txt" 2>"/hpc/stats/users/dbp2112/Janelia/logs/stderr.txt"

# NOTE: PBS mem=2gb has no universally portable Flux directive in a batch script.
# Performance implication: without a memory request/limit, the job may be placed where less memory is available,
# increasing risk of OOM or contention.

# NOTE: PBS -W group_list=hpcstats has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but accounting/authorization may differ; job could fail if group
# selection is required.

# NOTE: PBS -V (export all environment variables) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: if your Flux submission environment does not already propagate needed variables
# (e.g., config_path), the job may fail or behave differently.

# NOTE: Script references $PBS_ARRAYID but no PBS array directive is present.
# Provide ARRAY_INDEX when submitting under Flux.
# Performance implication: none for runtime if provided, but without it the job cannot select the intended patch.
: "${ARRAY_INDEX:?ARRAY_INDEX must be set to replace PBS_ARRAYID}"

/usr/local/bin/matlab-R2012b -r "addpath(genpath(\x27/hpc/stats/users/dbp2112/Janelia/quagga\x27)); roiFromPatch(${ARRAY_INDEX},\x27${config_path}\x27);"
'
"
}
